claim_boundary: Synthetic design-contract example only. It proves nothing about actual device performance, home layout, accessibility, security, fire/egress safety, usability, legal compliance or resident suitability.

goal.resident_statement: I want to know that a visitor has arrived and decide whether to respond without depending on internet access.
goal.observable_outcome: The resident receives a chosen notification through a declared path and can independently choose whether to respond.
constraints: A network outage must not silently remove every candidate notification path.
Notification does not imply consent to unlock a door or admit a visitor.
The resident owns the choice of notification modality.

nodes.title: Visitor generates an entry notification
nodes.note: Synthetic fixture assertion, not a tested device.

nodes.title: Network-dependent notification service
nodes.note: Availability, latency and resident compatibility have not been measured.

nodes.title: Chosen notification delivered through a network-dependent device
nodes.note: A proposal is not proof of usable notification.

nodes.title: Local tactile notification independent of internet
nodes.note: Verified only inside this synthetic fixture; power, placement and real operation are not tested.

nodes.title: Resident decides whether and how to respond
nodes.note: The intended outcome preserves resident agency; no door-unlock behavior is implied.

edges.note: Service-to-device delivery has not been tested.
Fallback edge is claimed only within fixture semantics and requires real-world validation.

paths.title: Network-dependent notification in normal operation
paths.success_condition: The resident receives their selected notification and decides whether to respond.
paths.note: Not evaluable because network-service needs site measurement and mobile notification is proposed.

paths.title: Local tactile notification when the network is unavailable
paths.success_condition: The resident receives the chosen local signal and independently decides whether to respond without internet access.
paths.note: Complete only according to synthetic declared-scope states; it is not a real-home pass.

failure_modes.title: Network-dependent service becomes unavailable
failure_modes.note: Fixture contract says a separately represented local path is available under this condition; no real device or environment was tested.
